prompt: An ethereal, dreamlike floral masterpiece where flowers exist beyond the physical world, melting, stretching, and dissolving into pure energy. Petals don’t just open--they ripple, swirl, and morph into fluid, ever-changing forms. Gravity is irrelevant, structure is abandoned--this is a living, breathing dream. The color palette shifts between dimensions, vibrating between pastels and cosmic brilliance: Holographic Amethyst (#9B5DE5) – glowing with an otherworldly aura Iridescent Celestial Blue (#3FC1C9) – resembling liquid stardust Lunar Blush (#F7C5CC) – a soft, radiant shimmer against the surreal darkness Cosmic Void Black (#1D1E33) – grounding the vision in deep, infinite contrast The floral elements don’t stay still--they pulse, expand, and drift, as if carried by an unseen force. Some petals appear translucent, others are reflective like liquid metal. They exist in a state of perpetual transformation, shifting between form and formlessness. Inspired by Dalí’s dreamscapes, the bioluminescence of deep-sea creatures, and the iridescent aesthetics of generative AI art. This is not just a floral painting--it is a portal into an uncharted dimension of botanical surrealism." --ar 9:16 --v 6.1
